description: We are a group of young, ambitious women and aspiring developers who are eager to explore the world of technology, learn new things, and find our place in the tech community. We may be at the beginning of our journey, but we bring curiosity, creativity, fresh perspectives, and a strong desire to grow together. We believe that being a great team is not just about technical expertise, but also about sharing ideas, supporting each other, and being willing to learn from mistakes.
